_doc: Multi-cell towns for the 3x2 town footprint (3 cells wide, 2 rows deep): the Lost World town and the goblin Warlord's Hold. Requested at 232x176 (about the footprint, 240x160, plus headroom for roofs and totems), then seated in a 240x184 canvas whose bottom 160 rows are the footprint and whose top 24 rows rise into the row behind. Bold black-outlined building class like the imported Pulp Wars cities; no flags (owner colour is shown by the interface). Layers: style, camera, light, faction (Lost World only), class-building, subject. A ground-removal edit follows when Pixen draws a plate. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: a big prehistoric Lost World tribal town filling the width of the image: a curved palisade of sharpened tawny logs across the front, in its middle a gate made of a giant cream dinosaur skull whose open jaws are the entrance, behind it five round huts with tawny thatch roofs and hide walls with big dark brown spots, one big longhouse at the back, a few dark basalt stones, and three tall cream bone totems with bright red-orange paint as the only accent. Buildings only.
recipes.negative: flag, banner, people, character, dinosaur, animal, metal, castle, stone wall, red roof

recipes.subject: Subject: a goblin warlord's scrap fortress filling the width of the image: crooked walls of riveted light grey tin sheets and spiked logs across the front with a big gate of bolted scrap plates crowned by two huge horns, behind them a lopsided junk watchtower, three tin shacks with bright hazard yellow roofs, a big tawny hide tent with brown spots and two smoking stove chimneys. Colours: light tin grey #b8bcc0 with #7d8288 shadows, hazard yellow #f2c230, tawny hide. Buildings only.

recipes.subject: Remove all ground: erase the green grass and the brown dirt path inside the log palisade, so the yard between the huts is transparent and nothing at all is drawn under the town. Keep the huts, the longhouse, the log palisade, the skull gate, the totems, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: Ground-removal edit: lost-world-a#0 has a grass disc and a path inside the palisade.

recipes.subject: Change only the ground: the green grass and the brown path inside the palisade become fully transparent. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the whole front log palisade, the big cream dinosaur skull gate in the middle of the front palisade, the huts, the longhouse, the totems, the outline and the art style.
recipes.notes: Second ground-removal edit: lost-world-a-clean erased the skull gate and the front palisade with the grass.

Colours: light tin grey #b8bcc0 with #7d8288 shadows, hazard yellow #f2c230, tawny hide. Buildings only.
